checks: Native FerroUI canvas contains rendered UI and document pixels
R shortcut and pointer drag create and render a selected rectangle
Keyboard undo removes the pointer-created node
Keyboard redo restores the node
Delete keyboard action removes the selection
Document JSON round-trip restores the complete edited document
SVG file import selects an editable frame with affine groups, gradients, curves, and Unicode text
PNG download has exact artboard dimensions and verified background, affine gradient, curved stroke, and text pixels
JSON round-trip preserves the complete imported SVG hierarchy and visual properties
Enter enters native vector editing; an anchor drag rebases bounds without moving other anchors and forms one undo/redo step
Native Pen pointer drags create a cubic curve and the complete path is one undo/redo step
Enter while the Pen pointer is held finalizes the gesture and ignores later handle movement until release
Native on-canvas TextBox handles multiline Unicode, UTF-8 rich-text ranges, Ctrl+Enter commit, Escape cancel, one-step history, and autosave
Browser composition events commit once, keep preedit out of the document, and cannot block or overwrite a new native text client after cancellation
Pagehide during unfinished composition durably saves confirmed Unicode and formatting, preserves one-step history, and survives a real reload
Native paint dialog pointer/keyboard input converts a fill to a gradient, edits alpha/opacity/stop positions, rejects NaN, and supports one-step stop undo
Native graph conversion, branching, stable-ID vertex dragging and edge subdivision preserve regions and exact one-step history
Native network Bend and Erase edit authoritative cubic edges, retain unrelated fill regions and serialize stable topology
Native character selection styles one non-BMP emoji at exact UTF-8 boundaries, retains selection across field focus, previews real inlines, clears overrides and restores one-step history
Native variable controls edit typed alpha colors, create aliases, bind layers, switch modes, rename collections, reject referenced deletion and preserve appearance with one-step undo
Native variant selection preserves descendant IDs, text overrides and placement with exact one-step undo and redo
Native exposed fields display effective direct text, visibility and component swaps; editing and Reset clear only the corresponding direct override with exact history
Native text, boolean and instance-swap controls apply typed Unicode overrides, preserve nested IDs and restore defaults atomically
Native main-component fields update instance defaults, rename a stable property without reverting its value, and create an exposed visibility binding with one-step history
Native multi-selection combines stable source IDs into a component set and adds a variant with remapped bindings while preserving original placement and transaction boundaries
Native image panning resolves Fill aspect, stores normalized UVs without changing bytes or bounds, produces verified PNG pixels, and restores one-step history
Native crop Escape, drag-to-origin, and Undo during capture restore the exact authored document and ignore late pointer events
Actual native crop corner dragging preserves retained source pixels through affine shear, changes the window bounds, and supports the native Done control and exact undo
Native percentage fields atomically apply and validate source windows, retain Fit letterboxing in actual PNG output, reset embedded source bytes without conversion, and preserve undo ordering
Native Tile source windows repeat at the cropped raster size with verified opaque pixels across the layer
PNG pixels prove group opacity is applied once to overlapping children through public FerroUI compositing
The native blend-mode ComboBox changes real Multiply pixels and retains exact one-step undo/redo
Real background-blur exports soften only the rounded geometry; native canvas pan reuses its cached surface without changing the document
Background blur preserves transparent PNG output and composes nested and own opacity without alpha inflation or host-background capture
Native inspector Add effect creates a typed drop shadow and restores the exact document with one undo/redo
Native effect fields author blur/spread, signed offsets, RGB and alpha; Up/Shift/Alt step by 1/10/0.1 ahead of TextBox caret handling, with exact one-step history
Native effect fields reject negative radius, nonfinite numbers, invalid alpha and malformed color atomically; Escape cancels drafts without a deferred blur edit
Native visibility and effect-type controls preserve typed stacks; Up reorders complete effects with exact one-step history and a rendered native dialog
Native Duplicate creates an independent typed effect; Remove retains remaining order and exactly restores the removed effect on undo
Empty selection exposes native page background and local resources; native color edits change canvas pixels, validate atomically, and undo exactly
Native one-based grid row, column and spans size a Fill child across tracks and gaps, update its Hug parent, exclude hidden/absolute layers and restore one-step history
Native grid controls reject overlapping cells and zero spans atomically; Reset to Auto removes placement metadata while retaining sizing and exact undo
Native Move after reorders automatic grid children while pinned cells and excluded layers retain placement; repeated no-op reorder adds no history
Native Move before follows reversed visual flow while preserving stored child identities, reverse settings and one-step undo/redo
Native child drags reorder row, column, reversed, wrapped, grid and affine layouts using exact world insertion markers; deferred previews preserve the document and each drop is one undo/redo
Native drag-return and Escape cancel immutable layout previews without document/revision/history changes; late pointer motion and release cannot commit a canceled drag
Native Undo during a held layout drag cancels only its preview; a second Undo restores the previous drop, and late pointer release preserves exact redo
Compact IndexedDB autosave flushes once during preview, preserves the authored overflow snapshot and Unicode, uses fewer bytes, and restores exact portable export on Escape
Real prototype hover (including locked layers), press, drag and key chord navigate frames; drag suppresses click and Escape restores authored state
The actual native dispatcher timer fires an authored After delay prototype interaction
Same-frame Press navigation suppresses a stale Click on mouse release
An authored Escape key interaction runs first; an unhandled Escape exits presentation
Direct bridge import during presentation becomes the authored document and survives Escape
Native FerroUI Clock renders Smart Animate midpoint position, size and brush color, then restores the exact authored document on exit
ScrollTo and actual native wheel input move clamped frame contents without panning the camera or changing authored nodes
Actual pointer hover/exit and press/release restore reversible prototype navigation; hover survives changed destination node IDs
All nine toolbar controls fit at 980×650; native toolbar pointer input switches tools
Native Add page clicks retain a scrollable page list and usable layer viewport at 980×650
A committed IndexedDB autosave restores the exact document after a real browser reload
Native nudge/undo/redo in 10,000 layers each prepare one leaf, rebuild no immutable visuals, and reuse the scene and layer projection
Native zoom into 10,000 layers narrows root bounds testing and paint candidates to the local viewport without dropping visible layers
10,000 rendered layers retain bounded native row realization, real pointer/nudge/undo/redo, and exact durable reload
